gcp.label: Google Cloud
gcp.guidance: Use IAM least privilege, Workload Identity Federation or attached service identities; Secret Manager; Cloud Logging. Do not create static service-account keys.

vercel.label: Vercel
vercel.guidance: Use project-scoped environment variables, preview deployments, managed identity/OIDC where supported. No GitHub Actions required.

cloudflare.label: Cloudflare
cloudflare.guidance: Use scoped API tokens, Workers secrets/bindings, Wrangler and environment-specific config. Do not expose admin DNS tokens to apps.

azure.label: Microsoft Azure
azure.guidance: Use Entra ID, managed identities, Key Vault, Azure Monitor, RBAC least privilege; do not assume Azure AD B2C migration is complete.

local.label: VPS / self-hosted
local.guidance: Use Docker rootless, localhost-only ports or Tailnet, project-scoped secrets and systemd jobs.
